title: Jesus... I Scroll Till 2 AM And Wake Up Hating It. 📱
topic: he scrolls his phone till 2 AM every night chasing a quiet he never finds, and wakes up ashamed of the hours he lost

bible.text: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I scroll till 2 AM and wake up hating it. 📱

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Another night, the same loop. My eyes are tired but my thumb won't stop.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That scroll isn't rest. It's comfort hunted in a place that can't give it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But it's the only thing that quiets my head after 11 PM.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Let Me be the quiet you're scrolling for. One psalm outlasts a hundred reels.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put the phone down at 11 tonight. Talk to Me. I never run out of battery.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend still scrolling at 2 AM. 📱
